CVE-2026-110716.title: unshield through 1.6.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnera ...
CVE-2026-110716.description: unshield through 1.6.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in unshield_get_file_table() that allows attackers to read past heap allocations via unchecked cabinet header offsets. Attackers can supply a crafted InstallShield cabinet with out-of-range file_table_offset or large file counts to crash the unshield tool or library consumers.
